input: Sign up for a local improv theater class

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Local Improv Theater Class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for an improv theater class offered locally.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the class be in?
questions.description: Understand the geographic area the user wants to search within for improv classes.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or have some experience?
questions.description: Determine the user's current skill level to match them with the right class level.

questions.title: What days of the week work for your schedule?
questions.description: Identify scheduling availability to filter classes that fit the user's week.

questions.title: What is your budget for this class?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with for enrollment.

questions.title: Do you prefer an ongoing class or a single workshop?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a multi-week course commitment or a one-time session.

questions.title: Is your goal performance, social connection, or personal growth?
questions.description: Understand the user's underlying motivation to help prioritize the right type of program.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person class over an online one?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user strictly wants a physical, local class or is open to virtual options.
